history.summary: IDENTITY UNCONFIRMED — placeholder. No shrine named 'Maa Pitambara Temple' in Jagdalpur has any web footprint; the CSV row cannot be matched to a documented referent. The famous Pitambara (Bagalamukhi) Peeth is at Datia, Madhya Pradesh (established 1920s by Swami Ji Maharaj). Within Chhattisgarh, documented Pitambara/Bagalamukhi shrines include one at Amleshwar near Raipur (established by Yogiraj Youdhishthir Maharaj, per thisismyindia) and a Maa Pitambara-Bagalamukhi Devi Mandir on Khudmuda Road, Patan — neither is in Jagdalpur/Bastar. Coordinates below are Jagdalpur city centre — APPROXIMATE. Navratri listed as customary observance only.

town_description: Jagdalpur is the headquarters of Bastar district in southern Chhattisgarh and the region's administrative and cultural centre, gateway to Chitrakote and Tirathgarh waterfalls and home of the 75-day Bastar Dussehra festival.
